1479-2841-8106-8337.easyPrerequisites:
There are two basic land cards in your library that share a basic land type.
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Myriad Landscape.
1479-2841-8106-8337.description:
Fetch a land using Myriad Landscape.
When the fetched land enters, M'Ress and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and M'Ress trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the M'Ress trigger from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, M'Ress triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

720-1806-2034-2324.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
720-1806-2034-2324.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge, adidng {C}{C}.
When Eternal Scourge dies, Kinzu of the Bleak Coven and Proper Burial trigger.
Resolve the Proper Burial trigger, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Kinzu of the Bleak Coven trigger, causing you to pay 2 life and exile Eternal Scourge from your graveyard to create a token copy of it that is 1/1.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Eternal Scourge token, adding {C}{C}.
When the Eternal Scourge token dies, Proper Burial triggers, causing you to gain life
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Repeat.

2279-3899-7084.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Quintorius triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

4571-5702-7824.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
4571-5702-7824.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Life
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-4753-6558.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-4753-6558.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Clever Impersonator and Naga Fleshcrafter each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Clever Impersonator trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Naga Fleshcrafter trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-4753-6558.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

1368-4289-5434-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-4289-5434-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

2724-3194-7638.description:
Blink Wormfang Manta using The Mind Stone. Wormfang Manta's first ability won't trigger due to Hushwing Gryff.
Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3967-6972-7509.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Gleeful Arsonist
When Gleeful Arsonist dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Gleeful Arsonist
When Gleeful Arsonist dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Yahenni abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
3967-6972-7509.notes: If Gleeful Arsonist starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

2043-3621-4786.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
Activate Claws of Gix by paying {1} and sacrificing the Su-Chi Cave Guard token.
When the token Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Resolve the Claws of Gix ability, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

1879-2440-7082-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
When Trusty Boomerang enters, Sokka and Suki's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When the Ally enters, Sokka's first ability and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Ally you control.
Resolve the Sokka trigger, attaching Trusty Boomerang to the Ally token.
Activate the Ally by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature and returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

719-5507-6871-6879.description:
Cast Inquisitive Puppet by paying {1}.
When Inquisitive Puppet enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, it and Haru trigger.
Resolve the Inquisitve Puppet trigger, causing you to scry 1.
Resolve the Haru trigger, earthbending Inquisitive Puppet as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Inquisitive Puppet by exiling it.
Toph triggers, returning Inquisitve Puppet from exile to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat steps 2 through 4 once.
Resolve the Inquisitive Puppet ability from step 5, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat from step 5.

1849-2366-2800-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
1849-2366-2800-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Mirari's Wake triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

527-5140-6798.manaNeeded: {G}, plus {R} if Selvala has summoning sickness
527-5140-6798.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 7 or greater that isn't Selvala.
527-5140-6798.description:
If Selvala has summoning sickness, activate Kenrith's first ability by paying {R}, giving all creatures haste until end of turn.
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {4}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Selvala.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {4}{B}, returning Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
527-5140-6798.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

1825-3861-6760.notablePrerequisites:
Orzhov Basilica and up to three other lands you control can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{W}.
Adagia has twelve or more charge counters on it.
1825-3861-6760.description:
Activate Orzhov Basilica and up to three other lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{W}.
Activate Adagia by paying {3}{W} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Treachery that is legendary attached to any creature.
If you control two legendary Treachery permanents, put one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Treachery token's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, untapping Adagia, Orzhov Basilica and up to three other lands.
Repeat.

2933-4499-4772.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Drowner of Hope.
When Drowner of Hope enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating four 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate three Eldrazi Scions by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

224-1772-5233-5478.description:
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Boros Garrison from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
When Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Holding priority, activate Boros Garrison by tapping it, adding {R}{W}.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger from step 2, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

1844-2921-5434-5555.notablePrerequisites:
You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
You have enough mana to cast Fateful Handoff.
1844-2921-5434-5555.description:
Cast Fateful Handoff by paying its mana cost, giving control of Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat from step 2.

864-1987-2239-4276.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
864-1987-2239-4276.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Ardent Elementalist and Eternal Witness.
When Ardent Elementalist and Eternal Witness enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
864-1987-2239-4276.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

465-643-1251-3742-4251.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

11-2103-5257.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying {3}{U}{U}.
Riku's first ability triggers - choose not to pay.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting Capture of Jingzhou.
Riku's first ability triggers, causing you to pay {U}{R} to copy Narset's Reversal, with the copy targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying the original Narset's Reversal targeting Capture of Jingzhou, and returning the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal created in step 5, copying Capture of Jingzhou and returning the original Capture of Jingzhou to your hand.
Resolve Capture of Jingzhou, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
11-2103-5257.notes: You may pay an additional {U}{R} to copy the extra turn spell, and only need to do this loop during your second extra turn.

2281-5231-5756.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Havi.
When Saffi dies, Havi triggers, returning any legendary creature card with mana value 1 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Saffi ability.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Havi, adding {R}.
When Havi dies, it and Saffi trigger.
Resolve the Havi trigger, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Saffi trigger, returning Havi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1314-2757-3705-5231.description:
Activate a basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Squee, untapping a basic land.
Activate a basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
When Squee dies, Brenard triggers, exiling Squee from your graveyard and creating a token copy of it that is a 1/1 Food Golem artifact creature token.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Squee token, untapping a basic land.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Squee token, adding {R}.
Cast Squee from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

2741-3000-5670.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
2741-3000-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Essence Warden triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

2829-5365-5445.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Clue.
Tarrian's Soulcleaver attached to Lonis.
2829-5365-5445.description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing a Clue.
Lonis' second ability and Tarrian's Soulcleaver trigger.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on any other creature you control.
Resolve the Tarrian's Soulcleaver trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lonis.
Lonis' first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

457-1486-3263-4222.notablePrerequisites: Freed from the Real attached to Magda.
457-1486-3263-4222.description:
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Magda, adding {U}.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Magda.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana, you may use it to activate Urza's second ability.

288-2092-4050.notablePrerequisites: Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 3 or greater.
288-2092-4050.description:
Activate Oketra the True by paying {W} due to Agatha of the Vile Cauldron, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Warrior, adding {W}.
Repeat.

2744-4702-4762.notablePrerequisites:
Splinter Twin attached to Devoted Druid.
Devoted Druid does not have summoning sickness.
2744-4702-4762.description:
Activate Devoted Druid by tapping it, creating a token copy of it with haste.
When the Devoted Druid token enters the battlefield, Cathars' Crusade triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Activate the nontoken Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Devoted Druid tokens, you may tap them to get infinite {G}.

1367-1982-3942.notablePrerequisites: You have not cast a creature spell using Karador this turn.
1367-1982-3942.description:
Cast Sidisi from your graveyard by paying {3}{B}{B}.
When Sidisi enters the battlefield, its exploit ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice Sidisi.
Sidisi's second ability triggers, causing you to search your library for Nexus of Fate and put it into your hand.
Cast Nexus of Fate by paying {5}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuffle Nexus of Fate into your library.
Repeat each turn.

255-1692-3951.notablePrerequisites:
Helm of the Host attached to Éomer.
Stangg does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Stangg.
You control another legendary creature that can attack this turn.
You have a way to kill the additional legendary creature at instant speed.
255-1692-3951.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Éomer with haste.
Declare Stangg and the additional legendary creature as attackers.
Stangg triggers, creating a 3/4 Stangg Twin creature token that is tapped and attacking.
Holding priority, kill the additional legendary creature.
When the creature dies, each Éomer that has not triggered this turn triggers, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get at least one additional combat phase after this one.
Move to your next combat phase.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Éomer with haste.
Declare Stangg as an attacker.
Stangg triggers, creating a 3/4 Stangg Twin creature token that is tapped and attacking.
Put either Stangg Twin token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.n: Invasion of Arcavios // Invocation of the Founders

914-1031-1883.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-1031-1883.description:
Cast Replication Technique by paying {4}{U}, targeting Invasion of Arcavios.
Replication Technique's demonstrate ability triggers, causing you and an opponent to copy it, with your copy targeting Dockside Extortionist.
Resolve your copy of Replication Technique, creating a token copy of Dockside Extortionist.
When the token Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least five Treasure tokens.
Resolve the original Replication Technique, creating a token copy of Invasion of Arcavios.
When the token Invasion of Arcavios enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Replication Technique to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}{U}.
Repeat.
If opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo will net infinite Treasure tokens.

259-2103-2963.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Teleportation Circle triggers, blinking Halo-Charged Skaab.
When Halo-Charged Skaab enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each player to mill two cards and put Capture of Jingzhou on top of your library from your graveyard.
Move to your next durn, drawing Capture of Jingzhou during your draw step.
Repeat.
